text:
پوہ دی مٹھ، ماہ دی بھری،
پھگن جہی چری نہ چری۔
romanized:
Poh di mutth, Mah di bhari,
Phaggan jahi chari na chari.
literal_en: A handful in Poh (December-January), a head-load in Mah (January-February) (is a good feed)—in Phaggan (February-March) it is no fodder at all
meaning_en: Said of green wheat; i.e. it loses its feeding-power.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
